content.title: How to watch Ole Miss vs. Arkansas men’s basketball: SEC Tournament TV channel and streaming options for March 14
content.text: The No. 3 seed Arkansas Razorbacks (24-8, 13-5 SEC) will play in the SEC tournament against the No. 15 seed Ole Miss Rebels (15-19, 4-14 SEC), Saturday at 3:30 p.m. ET live on ESPN.How to watch Ole Miss Rebels vs. Arkansas Razorbacks Venue: Bridgestone Arena Time: 3:30 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: ESPN Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. It is putting up 90 points per game to rank third in college basketball and is allowing 79.9 per contest to rank 329th in college basketball. Arkansas connects on 8.2 three-pointers per game (136th in college basketball), while its opponents have made 7.6 on average. Ole Miss has a -5 scoring differential, putting up 75.5 points per game (182nd in college basketball) and giving up 75.6 (231st in college basketball). Ole Miss makes 7.1 three-pointers per game (251st in college basketball), 1.3 fewer than its opponents. It is shooting 33.2% from beyond the arc (222nd in college basketball) and its opponents are shooting 33.5%.
